title: How Cities Map Hidden Groundwater — Sửa lỗi sau bài thi
teacher_only_evidence_text_en: A contamination plume is a zone in which affected groundwater spreads from a source through the subsurface. Its outline depends on flow, chemistry and the substance involved. A map showing a clean monitoring point cannot alone guarantee that nearby private wells are safe, because water can travel through different layers.
